name: Jet Jammer - DMG UP
RelatedDescription: This jetpack enables an ST to fly over short distances, quickly traversing obstacles to reach even the most inaccessible corners of the battlefield. Also integrates a function that affects the enemy's DMG UP capability.

61218.name: Flying Device I · DMG UP
61218.SpecificEffects:
ST Move Method changes to levitation, enabling ST to pass over low obstacles.
In combat, the enemy's DMG Taken <color=#F74848>+10%</color>.
ST Body's HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color>, DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
